title: Under the Fig Tree
old_p1: Micah was a prophet who lived long ago, in the same years as Isaiah. A prophet is a man who speaks for Heavenly Father.
Micah told about a happy time to come. He said families would sit “under his vine and under his fig tree.”
A vine is a grapevine. A fig tree has big, wide leaves that make cool shade. Families grew them right by their homes.
old_p2: Sitting under your own fig tree meant being home and safe, with good food close by. Micah said, “None shall make them afraid.” He said, “We will walk in the name of the Lord.” That means we follow Jesus every day.
Your bed can be your cozy fig tree tonight. Snuggle in and feel safe. Heavenly Father is watching over you.
p1: Micah told the people what Heavenly Father said. He lived long ago, in the same years as Isaiah.
In his day there was fighting, and the people felt worried. So Micah told them about a happy day to come. Nobody would fight anymore!
Each family would sit under its own grapevine and fig tree. Fig trees have big, wide leaves that make cool shade.
p2: Sitting under your own tree meant being home and safe. Micah said, “None shall make them afraid.” Micah chose to follow the Lord. He said, “We will walk in the name of the Lord.”
Your bed can be your cozy fig tree tonight. Snuggle in and feel safe. Heavenly Father is watching over you.
